subheadline: Three habits shape each release, from the first sketch to the finished styleguide.

items.title: Open source by default
items.description: Components, presets and the seeder are all GPL-2.0-or-later on GitHub. Issues and pull requests set the roadmap.

image.title: Team workshop
image.alternative: Colleagues discussing work around a shared table.

items.title: Audit before merge
items.description: An automated template audit runs in CI on every element. It allows no inline styles and no fixed colours.

image.title: Studio office
image.alternative: A bright office space with desks and screens.

items.title: Previews for editors
items.description: All 244 content elements have a real backend preview, so TYPO3 editors see the actual content, not grey boxes.

image.title: Whiteboard session
image.alternative: Two people sketching interface ideas on a whiteboard.
